subject: IR notification: onboarding evidence & SOC 2 retention clarification
messages:
From: Alex Rivera <alex.rivera@clearbridge.com>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>
Cc: security@clearbridge.com
Date: Fri, 16 Apr 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Urgent: brief security notification + request for IR playbook and evidence retention

Hi Naomi,

Quick heads-up from ClearBridge security — we observed anomalous API activity tied to one of our test tenants this morning. We don't believe customer data was exfiltrated, but we're moving to a precautionary path and need a few things from Redwood to close our audit loop:

- Your current Incident Response Playbook (latest version) and a point of contact for a short tabletop tomorrow.
- A list of SOC 2 / SIG / CAIQ evidence you can provide within 48 hours (sample logs, runbooks, redaction guidance).
- Clarification on your default retention window for token-level telemetry and access logs, and whether ClearBridge can request a longer snapshot for regulatory review.

If possible please attach a redact-friendly artifact bundle (or a Drive link) so our audit team can triage. We have a compliance deadline Friday COB.

Attaching: incident_summary_stub.txt (log pointers)

Thanks — really appreciate a quick turnaround.

— Alex
Alex Rivera
Head of Security Engineering
ClearBridge Financial
From: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>
To: Alex Rivera <alex.rivera@clearbridge.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 16 Apr 2027 09:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Urgent: brief security notification + request for IR playbook and evidence retention

Alex — thanks for the alert and the summary. We can support the ask and will prioritize the artifacts you mentioned. Quick plan:

1) I'll send an initial IR playbook snapshot and a redaction checklist within the hour.
2) Marissa (security evidence) will enumerate the SOC 2 / SIG / CAIQ mappings and expected delivery ETA.
3) Jonas (customer ops) will coordinate a 30-minute tabletop; suggested windows 10:30am–12:00pm or 3:00pm–4:00pm PT today.

A couple clarifying Qs before we ship logs:
- Are you able to accept redacted S3 extracts (we'll mask tokens and PII) or do you require full raw logs under an NDA?
- For retention: would you like a one-time extended snapshot for the tenant (we can preserve a rolling 14-day window), or a longer retention policy change request?

I'll attach a sanitized IR playbook excerpt now and follow with the evidence index.

Thank you,
Naomi Feldman
Customer Security Liaison
Redwood Inference
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>, Alex Rivera <alex.rivera@clearbridge.com>
Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 16 Apr 2027 11:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Urgent: brief security notification + request for IR playbook and evidence retention

Alex / Naomi — putting together the evidence index now. Summary (high level):

- Available within 24 hours: runbooks (IR_Playbook_v2.pdf), control mappings to SOC 2/CC2, SIG questionnaire answers (SIG-Redwood-2027.docx), CAIQ excerpt, and a list of available telemetry extracts.
- Logs: we can produce redacted S3 access logs and token-level telemetry snapshots scoped to specific tenant IDs; raw request bodies are retained for 7 days by default, structured metadata for 90 days.
- Retention options: one-time extended snapshot (14 days) — available on request and retained in a secure, timeboxed bucket with access logs and SHA256 checksums. Longer retention changes require an enterprise contract amendment.

Requested from you: the exact tenant ID(s) and the regulatory rationale for >14 days (if needed) so we can route an exception if appropriate. For expedited exchange, we can:
- Share a secure SFTP escrow link (temporary credentials, 48-hour window), or
- Place redacted artifacts in a shareable Drive folder (link below) and issue signed attestation.

Drive: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3c-IR-Playbook
Evidence exchange SFTP: sftp.redwood.com:/incoming/clearbridge (we'll provision creds after NDA acceptance)

Attachments to follow: IR_Playbook_v2.pdf (redacted), SIG-Redwood-2027.docx (mapping), retention_matrix.csv (mapping of artifact -> retention).

Marissa Cole
Security Evidence Manager
Redwood Inference
From: Alex Rivera <alex.rivera@clearbridge.com>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Nina Patel <nina.patel@finhaven.com>, security@clearbridge.com
Date: Fri, 16 Apr 2027 16:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Urgent: brief security notification + request for IR playbook and evidence retention

Thanks Naomi / Marissa — that matches what we need. Confirming:

- We'll accept redacted S3 extracts and redacted telemetry snapshots for the tenant (ID: cb-test-001).
- Please provision the SFTP credentials and a timeboxed bucket (48 hours).
- We request the 14-day extended snapshot for cb-test-001 to support an internal audit; regulatory reason: "pending formal inquiry from state regulator".

If you can provide the IR_Playbook_v2.pdf and SIG-Redwood-2027.docx in the Drive link + SFTP creds by EOD, we'll close the initial triage and escalate to our compliance reviewers. Please include a short signed attestation that artifacts were redacted per the supplied checklist.

Appreciate the fast response — we'll be on the 3:00pm PT slot if that works for your ops team.

— Alex
Alex Rivera
Head of Security Engineering
ClearBridge Financial
